primaryChecks.text: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
primaryChecks.previousContext: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.
primaryChecks.nextContext: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: The town is named as the place whose inhabitants heard what happened to Saul.
